payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the extractive models trained on the GameWikiSum dataset, including their performance and comparisons.

claims.text: The extractive models trained on the GameWikiSum dataset include TextRank, LexRank, SumBasic, C_SKIP, and SemSentSum.
C_SKIP and SemSentSum achieved the best results among the extractive models on the GameWikiSum dataset.
TextRank and LexRank performed worse than other extractive models on the GameWikiSum dataset.
SumBasic performed slightly better than TextRank and LexRank but did not achieve comparable results with embedding-based models.
